title: Offer Stop in the session view for an Idle session that has a pending delegation or test-run wait
outcome: A colleague can press Stop on a parent session that is waiting for delegations or test runs; today the view shows only a "waiting for delegations" indicator, and Stop appears only for active, approval or stopping sessions.
acceptance: The session view offers Stop for an Idle session with a pending delegation wait or test-run wait, and pressing it calls the Stop route (vitest).
Idle sessions with no pending wait show no Stop button, as today.

completion.summary: The session view offers Stop for an Idle session with its own pending delegation wait or test-run wait, in the composer and in the delegated-child footer; pressing it calls the Stop route. Idle sessions with no own pending wait show no Stop. Test-run wait membership comes from a context memoized on waits only. Landed with the backend brake (w-f917452faa71) in 6cd915ed; evaluation 74f59d5d passed 2/2.
